description: A synthetic T followed by an empty suffix is the restoration and nothing else. The written route that reads the synthetic and then derives suffix as empty would be a second derivation of the same omission, so it does not exist, and the check passes (engine §7.4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b
%rule a A [+T suffix]
%rule b A [+T suffix] [+T suffix]
%rule suffix ε
